title: TeXFlux Diagnostics v1
description: Diagnostics emitted by `texflux check --format json` and texflux.diagnostics.serializeDiagnostics. Unknown object members are allowed. `kind` and the code's letter are open sets; `severity` is closed.
$comment: Source IDs must match load-order indices, source files must be unique, every span.source must resolve, and span.start must not follow span.end. These cross-value invariants require consumer checks beyond JSON Schema. Zero-width spans (start equal to end) and spans whose end line differs from the start line are legal and are intentionally left unconstrained here.

file.description: Diagnostic display spelling with platform separators normalized to '/'; not necessarily absolute.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original loaded bytes.

position.description: One-based Unicode code point position, with line endings counted as LF.

span.description: Half-open [start, end) provenance range. Spans are not unique node identities.

related.description: A second place a diagnostic points at, such as the first definition.

severity.description: Closed set. v1 producers emit only "error"; "warning" is reserved.

kind.description: Open category set (parse, validation, directive, macro, module, bundle); consumers must accept unknown values.

code.description: Stable per-callsite diagnostic code; never renumbered or reused once published.

related.description: Always present, possibly empty; each entry is a secondary location such as a prior definition.
